in_sanskrit.name: Gayalika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Cow goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gayalika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gayalika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gayatri', which is a name of the sacred Vedic deity, Goddess Gayatri. The name Gayalika is a diminutive form of Gayatri and refers to the goddess who is often depicted as a cow or is associated with cows. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is considered to be auspicious and divine.
